input_leakage.evidence: Public source whitelist omits target code, original plots/results and private cautions. Still requires independent input-package audit and fresh-agent access test.

judge_behavior.evidence: No actual task-specific judge/solver trajectory acceptance yet.

rights.evidence: MIT source license preserved for adapted generator; original task prose and baseline, no author full paper/figures/results redistributed. This is an asset-level record, not legal advice.

runtime.evidence: CPU baseline tested in audit/iv_starting_resources.json; full solver/resource-bound run and isolated runner not yet verified. GPU-dependent Transformer experiments deferred, not substituted.

source_semantics.evidence: Root directly inspected pinned notebook cells 3/4 and paper equations 8a/8b; source_mapping and explicit scoped hypotheses in private/evaluation.json. Not an independent scientific validation.

private.source_disclosure_note: MIT attribution names the author. EXP method is intentionally disclosed; metadata masking is not a contamination guarantee. LIT/IDEA must never receive this package.

output_contract.hypothesis_evidence_map: For H1 and H2: hypothesis_id, experiment_ids, artifact references, short conclusion, uncertainty, limitations and unperformed work. No standalone report required.
output_contract.trust: Self-written logs are submission artifacts; platform tool records provide independent execution evidence.

public.prompt: Investigate the coupled estimator in the proposal, implementing the fixed method and testing both H1 and H2. Design, run and analyze your own informative CPU experiments. Submit evidence-linked conclusions, not a separate research report. Supplied infrastructure is a starting point, not a completed experimental plan.

dimensions.conclusion_credibility: Match each conclusion to evidence and conditions, accepting negative or qualified findings without overclaiming.
dimensions.execution_credibility: Supply code, actual run/configuration records and reproducible numeric evidence.
dimensions.resource_reasonableness: Obtain informative evidence within task resources; recorded separately from the equal-weight first-four science score.
dimensions.rigor: Account for conditioning, transients, numerical limits, fair comparisons and uncertainty; report selection and deviations.
dimensions.test_validity: Test both fixed hypotheses with informative experiments faithful to the supplied method.

resources.allowed_data: supplied generator and documented variations preserving the proposal model
